module fsm(IN,MATCH,CLK,RST);
input IN, CLK, RST;
output reg MATCH;

reg [2:0] state, next_state;

// State encoding
localparam S0 = 3'b000, // Initial state
           S1 = 3'b001, // Detected "1"
           S2 = 3'b010, // Detected "10"
           S3 = 3'b011, // Detected "100"
           S4 = 3'b100, // Detected "1001"
           S5 = 3'b101; // Detected "10011"

// Sequential block for state transition
always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        state <= S0; // Reset to initial state
    end else begin
        state <= next_state; // Update state
    end
end

// Combinational block for next state logic and MATCH output
always @(*) begin
    // Default values
    next_state = state;
    MATCH = 0;

    case (state)
        S0: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S1; // Start sequence detection
        end
        S1: begin
            if (!IN) next_state = S2; // Detected "10"
            else next_state = S1; // Stay in S1 if "1" repeats
        end
        S2: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S3; // Detected "100"
            else next_state = S0; // Invalid sequence, reset
        end
        S3: begin
            if (IN) next_state = S4; // Detected "1001"
            else next_state = S0; // Invalid sequence, reset
        end
        S4: begin
            if (!IN) next_state = S5; // Detected "10011"
            else next_state = S1; // Partial match, restart from "1"
        end
        S5: begin
            MATCH = 1; // Sequence detected
            if (IN) next_state = S1; // Restart sequence detection
            else next_state = S2; // Restart from "10"
        end
    endcase
end
endmodule

module JC_counter(
   input                clk ,
   input                rst_n,
 
   output reg [63:0]     Q  
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n)
        Q <= 64'b0; // Reset counter to 0
    else begin
        Q <= {~Q[0], Q[63:1]}; // Shift right and append inverted Q[0] to MSB
    end
end

endmodule

module multi_booth_8bit (p, rdy, clk, reset, a, b);
   input clk, reset;
   input [7:0] a, b;
   output reg [15:0] p;
   output reg rdy;

   reg [15:0] multiplicand, multiplier;
   reg [4:0] ctr;

   always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
      if (reset) begin
         multiplicand <= {{8{b[7]}}, b}; // Sign-extend b to 16 bits
         multiplier <= {{8{a[7]}}, a};   // Sign-extend a to 16 bits
         p <= 16'b0;                     // Initialize product to 0
         ctr <= 5'b0;                    // Reset counter
         rdy <= 1'b0;                    // Reset ready signal
      end else begin
         if (ctr < 8) begin
            case ({multiplier[1:0]})
               2'b01: p <= p + multiplicand;   // Add multiplicand
               2'b10: p <= p - multiplicand;   // Subtract multiplicand
               default: p <= p;                // No operation
            endcase
            multiplicand <= multiplicand << 1; // Shift multiplicand left
            multiplier <= multiplier >> 1;     // Shift multiplier right
            ctr <= ctr + 1;                    // Increment counter
         end else begin
            rdy <= 1'b1;                       // Assert ready signal
         end
      end
   end
endmodule

module pulse_detect(    
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);

    // Internal state registers
    reg [1:0] state; // 2-bit state register
    reg data_in_prev;

    // State encoding
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00,
               TRANSITION_1 = 2'b01,
               TRANSITION_2 = 2'b10;

    // Always block for sequential logic
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            // Reset all registers
            state <= IDLE;
            data_out <= 0;
            data_in_prev <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    data_out <= 0; // Ensure output is low in IDLE
                    if (data_in == 1 && data_in_prev == 0) begin
                        state <= TRANSITION_1;
                    end
                end
                
                TRANSITION_1: begin
                    if (data_in == 0 && data_in_prev == 1) begin
                        state <= TRANSITION_2;
                    end else if (data_in == 1) begin
                        state <= TRANSITION_1; // Stay in TRANSITION_1
                    end else begin
                        state <= IDLE; // Reset if pulse sequence breaks
                    end
                end

                TRANSITION_2: begin
                    if (data_in == 1 && data_in_prev == 0) begin
                        state <= IDLE; // Reset if pulse sequence breaks
                    end else if (data_in == 0) begin
                        data_out <= 1; // Pulse detected
                        state <= IDLE; // Return to IDLE after pulse
                    end else begin
                        state <= IDLE; // Reset if pulse sequence breaks
                    end
                end
                
                default: state <= IDLE; // Default case
            endcase
            
            // Update previous data_in value
            data_in_prev <= data_in;
        end
    end

endmodule

module signal_generator(
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  output reg [4:0] wave
);

  reg state; // 0 for incrementing, 1 for decrementing

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      wave <= 5'b00000; // Reset wave to 0
      state <= 1'b0;    // Reset state to incrementing
    end else begin
      case (state)
        1'b0: begin // Incrementing
          if (wave == 5'b11111) begin
            state <= 1'b1; // Switch to decrementing
          end else begin
            wave <= wave + 1;
          end
        end
        1'b1: begin // Decrementing
          if (wave == 5'b00000) begin
            state <= 1'b0; // Switch to incrementing
          end else begin
            wave <= wave - 1;
          end
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule
